entry.title: RVA Commuter Bike Bus, October 28
entry.content:
From RVA Commuter Bike Bus



This morning was the last commuter bike bus of the season! We were going back and forth on this, but ultimately, folks want to get into work when it’s cold, so we’re taking a page from our commuter bike bus friends in Raleigh and going on hiatus during the cold months. We had 13 weeks of bike bus this first season, and got to meet and hang out with lots of different folks on their way to work! We will be back in the spring, and we already have ideas on how to improve for next year!! If you ever came out, thanks for riding with us, and we hope you’ll join again next year. If you weren’t able to make it out, we hope to see you next season as well! In the meantime, please reach out if you have questions about bike commuting in the city or have feedback for how we can improve!! Safe riding, everyone! 💙🚲🚌

entry.title: RVA Commuter Bike Bus, October 14
entry.content:
From RVA Commuter Bike Bus



We want to make it easy for folks to link up with the bike bus where it makes the most sense for them. Below is an estimate of when we will pass by major landmarks along the route. These estimates are based on our last few weeks of riding, and they may differ slightly depending on group size, traffic, etc. We hope this clarifies the schedule, and, if it makes sense for your schedule, we hope to roll with y’all real soon! #bikecommuting #bikecommuter
